simple.meaning: מָצוּק (mâtsûwq) is a Hebrew word meaning “something narrow , i.e. a column or hilltop.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מָצוּק (H4690) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 1 Samuel 2:8, with occurrences in 1 Samuel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מָצוּק (H4690) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מָצוּק (H4690) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מָצוּק (mâtsûwq) / H4690 is traced through 1 Samuel 2:8, 1 Samuel 14:5 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
